rule: good. the gerund subject is treated as an occurrence trigger, which is the licensed route: a plain-variable tending condition carrying "sustained" and "solo", and a per-occurrence completion of the apprenticeship as the consequence.
texts: mixed: the rule now fires and the investiture is well built (the apprentice becomes a Keeper via a reified result state plus the flat fact), but the trigger-to-response link comes out as During, so the parse says the investing happens while the completing is going on rather than after it, and the tending is hung inside the group of nights with that same head. A relative-clause phrasing sidesteps the temporal link entirely: "Every apprentice who completes many solo nights of tending is invested as a Keeper by the Council."
